notes.title: Demo Maintenance Notice
notes.notes: [p]Hi Florist!, the Puni the Florist demo will be temporarily unavailable starting August 15th while we prepare an updated build.[/p][p]We’ll share more details and bring it back as soon as it’s ready, thanks for your patience![/p]

notes.title: 25,000 Wishlists Reached! 🎉
notes.notes:
[p]🎉 25,000 Wishlists in 4 Months! 🎉[/p][p][/p][p]We released the demo few days ago, and our wishlists have already jumped to 25,000! 😊🙏
Last week we were working ourselves to the bone, but seeing this makes it all worth it![/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone who stopped by to run the flower shop, streamed the game, or shared your lovely bouquets on [url="https://discord.gg/p8d7feCd2N"]Discord[/url] and [url="https://x.com/EarthquackGames"]social media[/url]. It really warms our hearts 💐[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you, florists! 🌷✨[/p][p][i]Earthquack Games[/i][/p]

notes.title: Puni the Florist is in Wholesome Direct 2025! ✨
notes.notes: [p]We're super excited to announce that [b]Puni the Florist[/b] will be part of [b]Wholesome Direct 2025![/b] 🌷  Get ready for the "long-awaited" announcement on June 7th, 2025! See you there, florist!   Huge thanks to Wholesome Games for this opportunity! ✨ [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518811/b06f7484fd147ad1316146f5e1c8aad1d7c0ca7b.jpg"][/img][/p]
